title: Norwegian-Style Cauliflower Toast
description: A crispy and flavorful toast topped with sautéed cauliflower and a hint of zesty Norwegian seasoning.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, melt 1 tbsp of butter over medium heat. Add the cauliflower florets and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Add the zesty Norwegian seasoning to the cauliflower and toss to coat.
4. Meanwhile, toast the Norwegian bread slices in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
5. To assemble the toast, place a toasted bread slice on a plate, top with a spoonful of the sautéed cauliflower, and drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp of butter.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
